answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 59942 Country: India Title: Regarding share of inheritance in case Question: Please tell me shares of inheritance about a person who has expired and has left the following relatives: Mother, one brother (married), two sisters (married), one wife and one son (unmarried). Answer ID: 59942 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 825/821/B=08/1436) In the question mentioned above all the property left by the deceased person shall be divided into 24 shares. Out of the total the wife shall get 3 shares, 4 shares shall go to the mother and the son shall take the remaining 7 shares. His brother and sister shall get nothing in the presence of the son. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x3=3 Mother: 1x4=4 Son: 1x17=17 Total: 24 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
